meta.title: Reduce Vercel deployment time by 2x
meta.body_summary: Reduce Vercel deploy time by offloading TypeScript checks to GitHub Actions and optimizing Webpack/build steps, aiming for ~2x speedup.

perf_labels.notes: Cursor PR to optimize Vercel deploy time introduced multiple bugs (dependency move, fragile Webpack logic) and failed Vercel build; closed without merge or perf evidence.

change_scale_vs_repository.interpretation: At 494 changed lines, this is a medium-sized build configuration change. As a performance optimization PR it was closed — the bot reviews revealed technical errors and the Vercel deployment failed, indicating the optimization was not functional.

review_details.concern_detail: Cursor bot flagged: unreliable TerserPlugin configuration, QR code dependency moved to devDependencies, SVG configuration incompatible with Turbopack, fragile ForkTsCheckerWebpackPlugin removal, and Radix UI version downgrade causing inconsistencies. Vercel deployment failed.
review_details.performance_claim: Reduce Vercel deploy time by 2x (6-7 min to 2-3 min) by offloading TS checks and optimizing Webpack.
review_details.rejection_signals: Multiple correctness issues and failed Vercel build; PR closed without merge.

capability_boundary.boundary_notes: Optimizing a monorepo build pipeline required precise configuration of Webpack, Next.js, dependencies, and Vercel settings; the agent introduced multiple errors that broke the build, showing limited capability with complex build tooling.

detection_detail.code_reading: Cursor bot performed static analysis and identified multiple bugs.
detection_detail.ci_auto: Vercel automated deployment failed, indicating build errors.

maintainer_practices.reproducibility_notes: No performance measurement or before/after data; only narrative claim accompanied by failed build.
maintainer_practices.regression_detail: PR closed by author after ~20 hours, with no subsequent fix for the identified issues.

core_change_summary.description: Optimized Vercel build by offloading TypeScript checks to GitHub Actions workflow, increasing Node memory, modifying Webpack config (TerserPlugin, removal of ForkTsCheckerWebpackPlugin), and adjusting dependencies; also added .vercelignore and updated turbo.json.
core_change_summary.secondary_note: Many changes involved dependency version adjustments and lockfile updates to fix build errors introduced by the optimization.
change_trajectory: Initial Cursor commits: build optimization (Webpack tweaks, TypeScript check offload, memory increase) and documentation.
Author added fix commits: updated pnpm-lock, resolved missing dependencies (semver, @radix-ui collection), downgraded Radix UI versions.
Vercel deployment failed; bot reviews flagged multiple issues; PR closed without merge.

review_signals.summary: Identified bugs: unreliable TerserPlugin config, QR code moved to devDependencies, SVG Turbopack incompatibility, fragile ForkTsCheckerWebpackPlugin removal.
react-qr-code moved to devDependencies, not available in production.
TerserPlugin config can cause TypeError due to missing null checks on options.
Radix UI package versions downgraded inconsistently with lockfile, causing potential runtime errors.
Vercel deployment failed on the PR branch.

collaboration_trajectory: Cursor agent opened PR with build optimizations; Cursor bot immediately posted a review with multiple bug flags.
Author attempted fixes via commits (lockfile, dependencies, Radix downgrade); Vercel deployment failed repeatedly.
No human review; PR closed after ~20 hours.
